member: Lena — Refrigeration and Thermal Insulation Engineer
message:
Surya, cold stored in produce itself bridges a sunless stretch for the device.

Plain words, one tonne of vegetables acts like a large cold water tank, so box drifts slowly upward without leaving safe band. Numbers are 1.94 kWh thermal buffer for 2 K rise from the thermal buffer 1 tonne for 2K rise (E67), against 376 W steady heat gain from the steady cooling load and pull-down for 1 tonne box (E24), giving about 5 h per 2 K, sane against household fridge staying cold for hours unopened.

Kofi, night load stays light on sealed box for the device.

Plain words, chiller sips like household fridge while insulated walls and door seals hold cold. Numbers are 150 W steady electric from the steady electric watts from Coefficient of Performance (COP) 2.5 (E51), where Coefficient of Performance means cooling per electric power, giving 2.10 kWh per 14 h night from the night energy at 150 W for 14h (E57), which is 41.0% of battery from the night fraction of 5.12 kWh battery (E58), sane against overnight household use.

Farah, no-batch rule protects uniformity for the device.

Plain words, adding no warm crates on cloudy day keeps 4-10 C band with fan and slatted floor doing mixing. Numbers stay inside 1.42 days holding-only autonomy from the autonomy days holding only (E66). Ready, because thermal buffer plus battery plus no-batch rule closes cloudy hold.
